title: CanonicalId
description: Canonical ID grammar cloud:customer:source:type:id. cloud is commercial or government; customer, source and type are lowercase [a-z0-9._-]; id is lowercase [a-z0-9._-] plus '/' and '='; no segment may contain ':'. Corpus: id-corpus.json. Python validator validate_canonical_id_fullmatch re-checks with re.fullmatch because Python re.search lets '$' match before a trailing newline.
